lead: A `catch` binding has no methods at all, and every PHP accessor on one is `E0405`.
body: `catch (Throwable $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }` is refused where it is written, with a help naming the property that answers the same question (`->message`); `nvs_types::expr::calls::report_exception_accessor` is that mapping's home. A case that wants to show what was thrown reads `$e->message`.
